claim_en: Settled.govt.nz states that a bank or lender will usually want proof that property insurance has been arranged before settlement.
quote: will usually want proof that you’ve arranged property insurance before settlement
source_title: What property buyers need to know about insurance - settled.govt.nz
licence: Copyright Real Estate Authority (not Creative Commons); may be reproduced free of charge for personal or in-house use only
next_step_en: Ask your lender what insurance evidence it requires and get insurance quotes early.

claim_en: The Natural Hazards Commission states that its building cover cap is generally $300,000 plus GST.
quote: is called the building cover cap and is generally $300,000 plus GST
source_title: About natural hazards cover - Natural Hazards Commission Toka Tū Ake
next_step_en: Check your private insurance policy for cover above the Natural Hazards Commission cap.

claim_en: The unittitles.govt.nz short guide states that the body corporate must insure the unit title property to its full insurable value.
quote: must insure and keep insured the unit title property to its full insurable value
source_title: Short guide to unit titles (May 2024) - unittitles.govt.nz (MBIE)
licence: Crown copyright (MBIE); reproduction for personal and non-commercial use permitted with the source indicated and disclaimers reproduced
next_step_en: Ask for the body corporate insurance policy and check whether you need separate cover for your unit and contents.

claim_en: The Natural Hazards Commission states that the maximum levy is currently $480 plus GST per year.
quote: The maximum levy is currently $480 plus GST per year
source_title: About natural hazards cover - Natural Hazards Commission Toka Tū Ake
next_step_en: Ask your insurer how the Natural Hazards Insurance levy appears in the quoted premium.

claim_en: The Natural Hazards Commission states that, for NHCover claims, the excess for a building claim is $500 per insured home.
quote: The excess for a building claim is $500 per insured home
source_title: About natural hazards cover - Natural Hazards Commission Toka Tū Ake
next_step_en: Ask your insurer about its own excess in addition to the Natural Hazards Commission excess.

claim_en: The Natural Hazards Commission says NHCover only covers land under the home and some related structures within 8 metres; other land is uninsured.
quote: some related buildings and structures within 8 metres of your home
source_title: About natural hazards cover - Natural Hazards Commission Toka Tū Ake
next_step_en: Ask your insurer and the Natural Hazards Commission which parts of the land are covered.
